description: 4 decimal GB whole-runtime envelope (4,000,000,000 bytes, 3.725 GiB), with the same 4 CPU quota and per-component CPU limits as M. Includes API, client, both permitted workers, CNPG Postgres, Pooler and Redis; excludes build jobs, load generation, fake providers, object storage and cluster infrastructure. Memory fit does not establish a worker-memory optimization or sustained capacity.
